title: DetourLab scenario v1
description: A bounded directed network, fleet, ordered jobs and permanent closures. This original MIT-licensed schema checks JSON structure; DetourLab runtime validation remains authoritative for references, record-ID uniqueness, UTF-8 size, UTF-16 string lengths and safety checks.

version.title: Scenario format version
version.description: The scenario format version is exactly 1.

name.title: Scenario name
name.description: Nonblank display label. The runtime limit is 120 UTF-16 code units.

seed.title: Fixture seed
seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer. Import preserves supplied geometry and demand; it does not regenerate them from this seed.

description.title: Scenario description
description.description: Nonblank explanation of the scenario. The runtime limit is 4000 UTF-16 code units.

nodes.title: Network nodes
nodes.description: One to 2000 planar coordinates. Node IDs must be unique; the runtime checks that separately.

edges.title: Directed roads
edges.description: Up to 8000 directed edges. A reverse direction exists only when supplied as another edge. The runtime checks unique edge IDs and node references.

vehicles.title: Fleet
vehicles.description: One to 100 vehicles with fixed start nodes and dispatch times. The runtime checks unique vehicle IDs and node references.

jobs.title: Ordered delivery jobs
jobs.description: Up to 2000 jobs. Each vehicle serves its jobs in their relative array order. The runtime checks unique job IDs and node/vehicle references.

closures.title: Permanent closure events
closures.description: An empty array means clear roads. A repeated edge across different events is allowed; its earliest cutoff wins.

durationS.title: Minimum playback horizon (seconds)
durationS.description: Greater than zero and at most 604800 seconds (7 days). Work continues until finished even when it exceeds this playback horizon.

identifier.title: Safe identifier
identifier.description: 1–96 ASCII characters; start with a letter or digit, followed by letters, digits, underscore, period, colon or hyphen. Reserved prototype-related values are prohibited.

label.title: Display label
label.description: Nonblank text with no U+0000–U+0008, U+000B, U+000C or U+000E–U+001F controls. Tab, line feed and carriage return are allowed. Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points; the runtime's 120-character limit counts UTF-16 code units.

coordinate.title: Planar coordinate
coordinate.description: Arbitrary planar units, from -1000000 to 1000000 inclusive. Coordinate spacing does not determine road distance or travel time.

timestamp.title: Seconds after scenario start
timestamp.description: A fractional or whole number of seconds, from 0 to 604800 inclusive (7 days). This is not a wall-clock timestamp.

id.title: Node ID
id.description: Unique within the scenario's nodes; edges, vehicles and jobs reference this ID.

x.title: X coordinate
x.description: Horizontal position in arbitrary planar units.

y.title: Y coordinate
y.description: Vertical position in arbitrary planar units.

id.title: Edge ID
id.description: Unique within the scenario's edges; closures reference this ID.

from.title: Origin node ID
from.description: ID of an existing node where this directed edge begins. The runtime checks the reference.

to.title: Destination node ID
to.description: ID of an existing node where this directed edge ends. No reverse edge is implied.

distanceM.title: Edge distance (meters)
distanceM.description: Modeled distance in meters, from 0.01 to 1000000 inclusive; independent of node-coordinate spacing.

travelTimeS.title: Edge travel time (seconds)
travelTimeS.description: Modeled traversal time in seconds, from 0.1 to 86400 inclusive (1 day).

roadName.title: Road name
roadName.description: Nonblank display label; different directed edges may share a road name.

id.title: Vehicle ID
id.description: Unique within the fleet; jobs reference this ID for their fixed assignment.

startNode.title: Start node ID
startNode.description: ID of an existing node where the vehicle starts. The runtime checks the reference.

startTimeS.title: Dispatch time (seconds)
startTimeS.description: Seconds after scenario start when this vehicle becomes available.

nodeId.title: Delivery node ID
nodeId.description: ID of an existing destination node. The runtime checks the reference.

vehicleId.title: Assigned vehicle ID
vehicleId.description: ID of an existing vehicle. Its jobs retain their relative order in the jobs array.

dueTimeS.title: Arrival deadline (seconds)
dueTimeS.description: Seconds after scenario start by which the vehicle must arrive. Arrival exactly at the deadline is on time; service completion is not the deadline test.

serviceTimeS.title: Service duration (seconds)
serviceTimeS.description: Time spent serving the job after arrival, from 0 to 86400 seconds inclusive (1 day).

id.title: Closure event ID
id.description: Unique within this scenario's closure list or this experiment variant's closure list. The runtime checks uniqueness.

edgeIds.title: Affected directed edge IDs
edgeIds.description: 1–8000 distinct IDs of existing directed edges. The runtime checks graph references. Repeating an edge in different events is allowed.

atS.title: Closure cutoff (seconds)
atS.description: Seconds after scenario start when affected edges close permanently. Entry exactly at the cutoff is blocked; a vehicle already on an edge finishes it.

closureList.title: Closure schedule
closureList.description: 0–8000 permanent closure events. Event IDs must be unique within this list; the runtime checks that separately.
